verdict.rationale: Godot documents a public object-oriented API that can drive the editor: EditorInterface can save and reload scenes and edit resources, EditorScript can run scripts, and a headless mode supports scripted automation. That API is reached in-process through scripts, plugins or the CLI, not through an external remote API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. A built-in LSP and a keyless Asset Library JSON API exist but cover only narrow surfaces. missing for 10: an external documented remote/HTTP control API, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), official agent-facing documentation of programmatic control, independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving the editor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
